title: fix(scenarios): name a card's master-detail as one in the build prompt, not as a lookup
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSCbDNJCsch4DU2SMg7a6cLW)_
Fixes #37760

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#5027 (M2 Build line), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#5080 itemisation (item C).

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感：评测给智能体的需求描述里，带「主从内联编辑」标签的六张场景卡，把明细关系单独写成「主从关系」一行，不再混在「查找」里。
- 属于「云端 agent 效果」专题：project 卡每次都因按「查找」建关系丢 2 分，这是卡片写法的问题。
- 只改评测卡与提示词，不碰评分，也不碰产品运行时；出错最多是某张卡提示词措辞不对，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.ts`: an `expect.lookups` row takes an optional `masterDetail: true` (the literal or absent). New export `MASTER_DETAIL_INLINE_EDIT_TAG`.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts` `structureLines()`: a marked row is stated on its own line, "Master-detail relationships, each a `master_detail` field (not a `lookup`) on the detail object referencing its master, the detail's rows entered inline on the master's form: ...", and the "Lookups" line keeps the rest (omitted when none is left). The row is still spelled `object.field` → `to`, so the exact-name trace (`prompt-trace.test.ts`) holds unchanged.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/loader.ts`: a card that carries `records-forms.master-detail-inline-edit` and marks no row is refused at `expect.lookups`.
- The six library cards that carry the tag mark their detail relationship: `invoice_line.invoice`, `task.project`, `order_line.order`, `claim_line.claim`, `leave_day.request`, `po_line.purchase_order`. The two control cards' `provenance` and the corpus-drift derivation (`scenario-cards.test.ts`) now say a master_detail fixture field yields a marked row.
- Both READMEs document the key. Changeset: `@objectstack/scenarios` patch.

Scoring is unchanged: `lookup:OBJECT.FIELD->TO` reads the target only, so a `lookup` and a `master_detail` both pass it, and the tag's own rows still judge the type. No denominator moves.

### Premise check (on `origin/main` 8b9b9d23)

- `structureLines()` at `prompts.ts:214-218` listed every `expect.lookups` row under "Lookups": confirmed.
- The cloud#5080 note says the project card's lookup row was "derived from a golden fixture that is itself a lookup". Not so: the `project_with_tasks` fixture in `packages/cli/src/lint/corpus.ts` declares `task.project` as `master_detail`; the card's derivation (one lookups row per lookup **or master_detail** field) dropped the type. The fix is the same, and the marker now carries the type the fixture has, so the control cards stay derived mechanically (the drift pin proves it).
- A prompt-only change cannot pick the row on the four mid-tier cards (several lookups each), so the card data names it. This widens the scenario-card schema by one optional key; the card format is a devx instrument, not the metadata protocol, hence `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### Prompt diff, all nine cards, all three prompts

27 prompts rendered before (base 8b9b9d23 source and cards) and after: the six tagged cards' build prompts change by exactly one line each; the three untagged cards' build prompts and all 18 iterate / template-iterate prompts are byte-identical.

<details><summary>project_with_tasks (build)</summary>

```diff
-- Lookups, each referencing the object shown: `demoproject_task.project` → `demoproject_project`.
+- Master-detail relationships, each a `master_detail` field (not a `lookup`) on the detail object referencing its master, the detail's rows entered inline on the master's form: `demoproject_task.project` → `demoproject_project`.
```
</details>

<details><summary>invoice_with_line_items (build)</summary>

```diff
-- Lookups, each referencing the object shown: `demoinvoice_invoice.account` → `demoinvoice_account`, `demoinvoice_invoice_line.invoice` → `demoinvoice_invoice`.
+- Lookups, each referencing the object shown: `demoinvoice_invoice.account` → `demoinvoice_account`.
+- Master-detail relationships, each a `master_detail` field (not a `lookup`) on the detail object referencing its master, the detail's rows entered inline on the master's form: `demoinvoice_invoice_line.invoice` → `demoinvoice_invoice`.
```
</details>

<details><summary>order_to_cash, travel_expense, leave_balances, requisition_to_receipt (build)</summary>

Each: the named row leaves the "Lookups" line (every other row in its order) and a master-detail line follows it:

```diff
+- Master-detail relationships, ...: `demoorder_order_line.order` → `demoorder_sales_order`.
+- Master-detail relationships, ...: `demotravel_claim_line.claim` → `demotravel_expense_claim`.
+- Master-detail relationships, ...: `demoleave_leave_day.request` → `demoleave_leave_request`.
+- Master-detail relationships, ...: `demopurchase_po_line.purchase_order` → `demopurchase_purchase_order`.
```
</details>

## Tests

- `test/runner/prompt-trace.test.ts`: per tagged card, the build prompt's master-detail line names every marked row and the Lookups line names none; per untagged card, no master-detail line and the Lookups line equals the pre-change rendering of every row.
- `test/refusals.test.ts`: the tag with no marked row is refused at `expect.lookups`; `masterDetail: false` is refused; control: tag plus a marked row loads clean.
- `test/score/scenario-cards.test.ts`: the corpus derivation marks a `master_detail` field, so the two control cards still equal what `corpus.ts` derives.

Local, on head `202d622e`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && typecheck && exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 44 passed (44), Tests 1374 passed (1374).
- Reverse check: with `prompts.ts` restored to base 8b9b9d23, `prompt-trace.test.ts` fails exactly the six new "names its master-detail as one" cases; restored file byte-identical to the commit (`git hash-object` match).

<details><summary>Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 68 run, 65 exit 0, 3 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- 65 commands exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (reads every package's dist; only the scenarios closure is built here).
- NOT MEASURED, reason: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3, its positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` hit the local 300 s cap (exit 124).

CI runs all three.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The tag rows (`master-detail-field-exists`, `master-detail-inline-edit`) are untouched; the expected gain is the project card's 2 median points (cloud#5080: 6 points over 3 runs), measured on the next scenario round, not here.
- No re-run of the eval in this PR.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts` `structureLines()` (the split), then `src/loader.ts` (the new refusal).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/prompt-trace.test.ts`, expect every case green, including six "names its master-detail as one" cases.
